description: Terminal close causes sent by the bridge on the terminal websocket and decoded by the web client. The Rust serializer (bridge/src/web_bridge.rs) and the TypeScript decoder (web/src/terminalConnectionStatus.ts) must both agree with this file; tests on both sides read it as the contract.

retry_values.attach-conflict: Bounded fast retries (client keeps a separate counter) before treating the conflict as genuine.
retry_values.stop: Do not reconnect; show the closed state and block input.

causes.example_daemon_prose: terminal attach failed: terminal term_ab12 already has an attached client
terminal attach taken over by another client
terminal attach failed: terminal term_ab12 not found
